Notes: Anyone who is in this squad cannot harm or be harmed by the player
Will attack anyone that isn't in their squad regardless of faction
Can still commit friendly fire on squadmates
Will not attack anyone and cannot be hurt
All arena enemies are automatically set to this faction

Warnings: Do not set as [DefaultFaction] for characters
Spawns with a lower tier of weapons in Arena Mode
Does not swap weapons, pick them up, or side step in combat
Does not attempt to dodge hazards
Does not throw grenades (Unless Weapon has [MindlessUsable] trait)

Hunter.Description: Will be aware of nearest target and be automatically set to aware stance

Coward.Description: Will flee from target if it's too close
Notes: Will also use [FriendDied] chatter

Personal.Description: Will always try to close the distance to target regardless of ideal engagement distance

Turtle.Description: Will seek cover much more often

Notes: Has a 50% chance of being a snap dodge if character has [SnapDodge] skill
If [Personal] behavior applied, will always snap-dodge towards target

Enraged.Description: Will attack more frequently for a short time after being struck

ItchyFinger.Description: Sustains a ranged attack for longer bursts

WhiteNinja.Description: Will not wait its turn to engage in melee combat
Warnings: Does not apply to [Tough] or [Madness] difficulty

ChargeUpLover.Description: Will use charge-up attacks much more frequently

BadBlock.Description: AI will attempt to block regardless of skill
Notes: AI typically require [BetterBlock] or [BetterGuard] to decide on doing so. This will override it.

FavorDual.Description:
Will attempt to pick up two weapons from the field
[Does this work?]

Accurate.Description: Will attempt to off-hand aim more often with ranged weapons

SlowWitted.Description: Has a slight delay before attacking
Notes: Melee units are more inclined to block with this behavior

Tactical.Description: Will move with respect to the squad leader, and form attack positions surrounding the player
Notes: Squad leader is generally the unit with the highest [Level], who has to be level 5 or higher

ChargeUpASAP.Description: Will always use the first level of charge-up attack

ThrowsOften.Description: Will throw its melee weapon when far enough away from target
Notes: Will not throw ranged weapons until they are out of ammo

Focused.Description: Will not shift focus to new targets until current one is dead

ADD.Description: Will randomly choose targets even when engaging one

FarSight.Description: Can see and engage targets from off-screen

Indirect.Description: Will weave towards target with an uneven path

Bubble.Description: Will attempt to space out from targets when using a ranged weapon

HotFoot.Description: Always tries to move around, makes for erratic movement

Camper.Description: Will hold position at a sniper node, and retreat to a new one if target is too close

Sniper.Description: Will use sniper reticle to fire tac-ignoring shot on target
Notes: Engagement distance is greatly increased with this behavior
Grace period of reticle is dependent on [Level]

Sharky.Description: Will attempt to circle strafe around target before engaging

FreeAttacker.Description: Will freely swing at or engage the player regardless of turn order
Warnings: Does not include navigation within melee distance, see [WhiteNinja]

TargetShy.Description: will navigate around character's aim direction

HoldCover.Description: Will seek cover around desired area

SprintOnlyInPursuit.Description: Will only sprint while chasing target

Deadly.Description: Will attempt to execute dizzied targets
Notes: Automatically applied to characters with [Bot] controller

GetAwayFromMe.Description: Will attempt to pistol whip or special strike targets more frequently when using a ranged weapon

TattleTale.Description: Will retreat to squad leader and wake up the whole squad if leader is unaware

Notes: Character will perform an [EmoteAngry] animation before charging
Character will perform the [DashSpecial] animation as a dash attack

TurtleForever.Description: When a cover point is found, will stay in cover forever
Warnings: Generally used in story missions where they are given specific cover points. Don't apply as a general behavior.

RearSmash.Description: If flanked from behind, perform a [RearSmash] animation

NoWakeupAlertAllies.Description: Will not wake up squadmates after finding a target

GrappleMasher.Description: Will be more aggressive in grapples

ForeverAutofire.Description: Will hold down the trigger on automatic weapons until ammo depleted

Catlike.Description: No delay between hitting the floor as a ragdoll and recovery

LeapSlam.Description: Will jump high into the air in an attempt to land on the target with a slam attack
Notes: Leap animations determined by [FallLand] animation
Slam Attack determined by [SlamExplode] property

LeapGrappler.Description: Will jump at the target and grapple with them if connection is made on landing
Notes: Leap animations determined by [FallLand] animation

ChargeAttack_Bullrush.Description: Will perform an angry charge attack at the player. Contact will ragdoll and dizzy the target
Notes: Character will perform an [EmoteAngry] animation before charging
If character collides with a solid surface or another bullrushing ally, will use the [Bullrush] animation

ChargeAttack_Grapple.Description: Will perform an angry charge attack at the player, contact will result in a grapple
Warnings: Deprecated, use [DashSpecial] with grapple event instead

Teleport_DodgeFlank.Description: Will teleport next to target if too far away
Warnings: Uses [OverrideDodge] animation, which requires a teleporting event

Teleport_DodgePursue.Description: Will randomly teleport closer to target
Warnings: Uses [OverrideDodge] animation, which requires a teleporting event

NoPathing.Description: Will not navigate by any means

CounterAttacks.Description: Will attempt to perform a perfect break or block while stunned
Notes: Probability is determined by [Level] and number of hits

LeapPursue.Description: Will attempt to leap towards the target if too far away
Notes: Jump animations determined by [FallLand] animation

NoCombat.Description: Will not be registered as a combatant

Teleport_Panic.Description: When a corpus block is broken, will teleport around the room 3 times

NeverHeavyH2H.Description: Never attempt to perform heavy attacks

NoMeleeFlocking.Description: Slight delay in pursuing target after target retreats

Notes: Can still perform special strike and behavior based attacks

JamAttack.Description: Will always try to attack, most aggressive form of attacking

UsePatrolPath.Description: Always follows a designated patrol path

UseGuardPosts.Description: Stays at a designated guard post

MagicWandAllAutos.Description: Will wave aim with all ranged weapons when attacking

ChargeUpMax.Description: charge-up attacks will always go to maximum level

IgnoreSiege.Description: Will not follow orders in staging area to attack siege targets

SpreadsJoy.Description: After killing or ragdolling a target, will perform a [Congratulate] animation with a nearby ally
Notes: If chosen ally has their own [Congratulate] animation, will use that instead

Civilian.Description: Has the keys to their own house

Security.Description: Can spawn from heist police cars

Marshmallow.Description: Can unlock the marshmallow box in [Hard Sell]

ReflectBullets.Description: Deflected bullets will travel in the direction of your aim as though you had shot them, allowing you to return fire back at your assailants.

Unwavering.Description: You stand firm under fire. Taking Tac-Damage or full bodily damage does not hinder your aim whatsoever.

HeavyArms.Description: Heavy firearms can be braced for aim, moved normally, and otherwise treated as a traditional weapon.

DisarmingShot.Description: A center-mass shot on a reloading target will disarm their firearm, even if they Tac-Dodge the attack.

MagicBullet.Description: Unless it's a wall, your shots tend to ricochet of of objects in the stage and find their way into the backs of opponents. Some luck!
Notes: Aim [RMB] at stage objects and fire!

Reciprocate.Description: Take the kinetic energy of the last attack you blocked, and quickly follow with a punch of your own to deal mega damage.
Notes: Attack with Unarmed after Blocking

MegaFinish.Description: Your unarmed kills are so mighty that they rock nearby opponents like the clap of thunder, knocking some of them to the ground!

Acrobatic1.Description: Improve the quality of your Dodge.
Notes: Press [Space] to dodge.

MovingTarget.Description: Take less Tac damage while moving.

TacticalNovice.Description:
Your first level of Tac-Bar, which converts incoming gunfire into grazes.

Certain conditions "downgrade" this graze back to a normal hit, such as being dizzied, struck from behind, over-encumbered, or within an opponent's Sweet Spot.

Your Tac-Bar does not protect you when ragdolled.

DeadlyThrow.Description: Your thrown melee or ranged weapons ignore your victim's Tac-Bar, and always count as a critical hit.

AthleticSprint.Description: Move your feet a little faster by sprinting in a direction along flat terrain. Although you'll hit your maximum sprint speed instantly now, you still lack the ability to fire a ranged weapon while sprinting.
Notes: Double tap a direction, or hold [Caps Lock]

FastGetup.Description: When knocked to the floor, rising again happens more quickly.

PreciseThrow.Description: Put a perfect spin on thrown melee weapons. Less likely to bounce away, and better damage.

Acrobatic2.Description: Improve the quality of your Dodge.

PickupKick.Description: Pickup items with a kick of your foot, equipping you with weapons much more quickly.

PickupLeaping.Description: Pickup items while moving, and be invincible while doing so.  This will only occur when enemies are in the room.

ShootDodge.Description: You can now fire your weapons while dodging.

SnapDodge.Description:
Zip to the side or out of the way of incoming attacks, or fly forward to close with a melee attack. You won't be invulnerable as with a normal dodge, but you'll be out of danger much more quickly. 

Snap-Dodge is melee cancellable.
Notes: Quickly Tap [Space]

TacticalJourneyman.Description:
Your second level of Tac-Bar. Incoming gunfire is now considered a full miss.

The same conditions can downgrade this miss into a graze as with Tactical Novice. Conditions can stack to bring this attack all the way back down to a hit (such as being hit in the back while dizzied).

CatchThrown.Description: Thrown melee weapons and firearms can be caught right out of the air.
Notes: Hold [Q] with your main hand empty.

LethalBluntThrow.Description: Firearms and blunt melee weapons will count as piercing weapons when thrown, negating their damage penalty.

MadarangDisarm.Description: The Madarang is a special throwing weapon with the potential to disarm opponents when struck. This skill unlocks that ability. Be warned: some few enemy types cannot be disarmed.

ShurikenThrow.Description: Whip tiny thrown weapons at enemies with lightning speed.

FallTumble.Description: Falling from reasonably high ledges will deal far lesser damage.

Plummet.Description: You're considered to be in a full dodge while falling through the air.

TimedKipUp.Description: Being knocked to the floor will be mitigated with a much quicker recovery.
Notes: Tap [Space] just before contacting the ground while in ragdoll.

Acrobatic3.Description: Improve the quality of your Dodge.

SprintFire.Description: You've learned how to engage your firearms while sprinting across the battlefield.

TacticalMaster.Description:
Your second level Tac-Bar acts as a passive, first level Tac-Bar when depleted, giving you constant protection even after your bar is gone. This passive protection may still be downgraded as normal.

You are now also protected while ragdolled, though this counts as a downgrade.

Lawnmower.Description: Slashing melee weapons will be thrown sideways and chop through as many opponents as possible before hitting the ground.

ShurikenArc.Description: With a little flick of the wrist, your thrown shurikens will slightly heatseak toward your target. Some weapons will even boomerang back to you, such as hook weapons.

ThrowBig.Description: Throwing heavy weapons is as easy for you as any other.

FallRoll.Description: With practiced timing, you can negate falling damage from all but the most egregious heights.
Notes: Tap [Space] just before contacting the ground.

HeadLeap.Description: Pop over the head of an enemy you're facing.
Notes: Hold shift and tap [Space] while facing an enemy.

TacSprint.Description: While Sprinting, you will ignore a single downgrade to your Tac-Bar from enemy gunfire due to conditons such as being attacked from behind, being dizzied, and so on.

Melee1.Description: Improve the quality of your Melee attacks.
Notes: Press [LMB] to swing a weapon.

CritSwing.Description: With proper timing, your melee swings will deliver critical forces to opponents.
Notes: Tap [LMB] just before your current hit lands.

LightSwing.Description: Your first light swing in a combo will be incredibly fast.

MinorLeague.Description: Melee attacks that deal more damage than an opponent's full Corpus will destroy that Corpus outright - no need for a finisher attack!

Positioning.Description: Quickly dart forward to close with opponents when wielding a melee weapon.

BasicBlock.Description: Use your melee weapon like a shield to block attacks from an opponent's melee or unarmed attacks. Incoming corpus damage will be significantly reduced, but only against enemies in front of you. For now, you can only block a single attack at a time.
Notes: Hold [RMB] while equipping a melee weapon.

BetterBlock.Description: Your melee and shield block can be maintained after the first attack.

Melee2.Description: Improve the quality of your Melee attacks.

BigWeapons.Description: You wield large weapons based on your Attributes, rather than automatically defaulting to an encumbered swing. Does not apply to truly massive weapons.

BlockBreaker.Description:
If your melee weapon is bigger than theirs, you can knock an opponent's guard to the side with your heavy attacks, and possibly disarm them if your hit is a Critical. Opponents with Tac-Bar remaining can maintain their block, but it'll cost them.

Unfortunately, this will not affect opponents larger than you or who carry shields.

BluntKnockback.Description: Blunt melee weapons, when swung heavily, will often drive opponents to the floor, allowing you to control your position on the battlefield.

FocusSwing.Description: Your melee attacks can be charged up and let loose for terrifying damage.
Notes: Hold [LMB] and release.

EdgedTiming.Description: Time your light bladed weapon attacks properly during a quick (non-Heavy) swing in order to carry through to the next attack very quickly.
Notes: Tap [LMB] just before your current light swing lands.

CritSwingBonus.Description: Critical melee hits count for two in your current combo, making your attacks in a combo even faster.

DualMelee.Description: You can carry another melee weapons in your off-hand. Most normal sized weapons and larger in your second hand will encumber your attacks, however. Only weapons you can carry in a single hand may be dual wielded.
Notes: Hold [Q] and target weapon with [RMB].

AdvancedBlock.Description: Your melee block offers much greater protection when aimed directly at an attacker.

BlockAiming.Description: You can adjust the direction you're blocking by aiming in that direction.

BlockMobility.Description: Movement is possible while defending with a melee weapon.

AdvancedBlockMobility.Description: Moving while defending with a melee weapon is totally unhindered.

Parry.Description: Stagger your opponents when responding to their attack with a perfectly-timed block. One-handed or dual wielded weapons only, please!
Notes: Tap [RMB] just before an opponent's hit lands.

Melee3.Description: Improve the quality of your Melee attacks.

EdgedSpeed.Description: Attack more quickly relative to combo counter when using an edged weapon.

AdvancedDualMelee.Description: Normal sized melee weapons can be wielded in your off-hand without encumbering your attacks.

FollowThrough.Description: Your slashing weapons deal full damage to all opponents struck during a heavy melee attack, not just your primary target.

ZipAttack.Description: Once you reach a 10+ hit combo while wielding a bladed weapon in your main hand, you can fly great lengths across the battlefield to close with distant enemies.

BlockBullets.Description: Bullets fall harmlessly to the ground when blocking with your melee weapon.

DeflectBullets.Description: Blocked bullets bounce away and may even impact nearby opponents.

Riposte.Description: Dual wielded weapons immediately strike back with lightning speed when Parrying.

Ranged1.Description:
Start with one extra magazine per non-Heavy firearm at the start of a stage. This ammo stacks with the magazines of any other firearm you start with that uses the same ammo type.

Also, you now hold your gun upright like a professional.

Quickdraw.Description: Nearly instantly draw your ranged weapons.

StationaryRecovery.Description: Standing still will improve your recoil recovery.

GreatShot.Description:
Ranged attacks that deal more damage than an opponent's full Corpus will destroy that Corpus outright. They don't need to be plugged with a finishing shot.

Shots that wouldn't kill in one hit must still drain the enemy's Corpus first before breaking it.

Headshot.Description: Understanding target vulnerabilities is important, which is why you can aim higher on an opponent to put one right between their eyes.
Notes: Hold [Shift] while wielding a ranged weapon.

OffHandAim.Description:
Bracing your gun with your off-hand lowers the recoil of shots fired and boosts your general accuracy. Plus you look like a boss while doing it.

While bracing an automatic weapon, light trigger pulls will fire off a single round rather than the full burst.

Unfortunately, moving will cause your aim to drop.
Notes: Hold [RMB] while wielding a ranged weapon.

SweetSpot.Description: Every firearm has its intended range. If you can land a shot on an opponent while they're standing in that zone, you will be more effective against their Tac-Bar by upgrading misses to grazes or grazes into full hits.
Notes: Your aim reticle will indicate Green for your weapon's Sweet Spot.

Ranged2.Description: Start with two extra non-Heavy magazines per firearm.

AutoFireComp.Description: Firing an automatic weapon offers an initial kick, but after a moment of continuous rapid fire, you're able to reduce your recoil significantly. Just don't release that trigger!

CoverBracing.Description: Firing over cover objects decreases the recoil you sustain.

DirectionTracking.Description: Changing the direction you're aiming is taxing for most people. Not you, though. Rapidly altering your aim no longer incurrs accuracy penalties.

Highground.Description: As you spit ammo downwards on your opponents below you, you'll find you deal more Tac-Damage to them because of your height advantage.

Unphased.Description: Your aim doesn't suffer for graze attacks inflicted by attackers.

DualRanged.Description: Wield medium-sized weapons or smaller firearms in your off-hand. You cannot dual wield while holding a two-handed weapon in your main hand.
Notes: Hold [SHIFT] and press [Q], or hold [Q] and target weapon with [RMB].

PistolWhip.Description: Your one-handed firearms can be swung in a Melee attack. Useful for bashing brains. Even more useful with a bayonet attached!
Notes: Tap [MMB] with a Firearm equipped.

Unobstructed.Description: Your bullets have a chance to pass through opponents if they take enough damage and lose a corpus from that hit.

ZeroTolerance.Description: Your enemies fear you, for they no longer need to be Finished by any ranged attack you deliver. If a shot would overcome an opponent's current Corpus Block, it is broken without needing to empty it first.

AimAssist.Description: While bracing your ranged weapon, you'll be shown a clear direction the bullet will travel.
Notes: Aim Assistance can be disabled from the pause menu.

CriticalShot.Description: Any opponent fired upon within your weapon's Sweet Spot zone will receieve a Critical Hit. Those killed this way will fall to the side and out of your line of fire, making further attacks on oncoming opponents easier.

MobileAim.Description: Oh, would ya look at that? You can maintain your aim while moving, although you won't be moving at full speed.

Ranged3.Description: Start with three extra non-Heavy magazines per firearm.

AutoFireCorrect.Description: Even if you release the trigger, your Autofire Compensation will continue to reduce your recoil once you begin shooting again. Just don't wait too long!

MobileAcc.Description: Moving around the field of combat will no longer penalize your accuracy in any way.

PerfectSights.Description: Tagging an enemy with a shot instantly bumps down your recoil.

AdvancedDualRanged.Description: Wield two of any firearm you can lift with one hand.

ShotgunBlastoff.Description: If your point-blank shotgun attack robs an enemy of Corpus, it'll send them flying away in a shower of blood and shame. Other than being a ton of fun, this has a high chance of frightening nearby opponents.

Deadeye.Description: Grazing hits can now break an enemy's Corpus when using firearms.

PinDown.Description: Enemies struck by, or Tac-Dodging, your shots will stop in their tracks. Larger enemies may only be slowed down.

PrecisionShooter.Description:
Dodging enemies take grazing damage from your shots rather than outright evading damage. 

Also, enemies Tac-Dodging your Sweet Spot shots will have their bars drain instantly, rather than waiting for them to drain over time.

Unarmed1.Description: Improve the quality of your Unarmed attacks.
Notes: Press [LMB] when unarmed.

CritPunch.Description: Using precision and timing, your unarmed swing will land with critical devastation.
Notes: Tap [LMB] just before your current hit lands.

LightPunch.Description: Your first light punch in a combo will be incredibly fast.

Footwork.Description: You have mastered balance and placement in an unarmed bout. You'll dart toward enemies to deliver your punches, rather than hoping they didn't have anything better to do than to wander into your range.

SpecialStrike.Description: Push attackers away with a vigorous shove.
Notes: Hold [Shift] and tap [MMB].

BasicGuard.Description: You know how to put up your dukes, but now you've learned how to block your opponent's. Without more training, your guard won't withstand more than one hit, and it'll be useless against melee attacks.
Notes: Hold [RMB] while unarmed.

BetterGuard.Description: Replace your little noodle arms with big slabs of beef that never get tired, and a block that does not break after the first hit.

Unarmed2.Description: Improve the quality of your Unarmed attacks.

FocusPunch.Description: Charging up your swing will lend it terrifying power when it lands.
Notes: Hold [LMB] and release.

CritPunchBonus.Description: Everyone will know how tough you are when your critical hits count for two combo hits rather than one, making your attacks in a combo even faster.

Ablation.Description: Reduce an opponent's Tac-Bar as you pummel them.

DashAttack.Description: Throw your shoulder into a dizzying attack when dashing!
Notes: Tap [LMB] while sprinting.

ImprovWeapon.Description:
Your broken melee weapon will leave you with a hilt that lets you execute opponents for free. You'll lose the item, but they'll lose their Corpus. Fair trade.

This auto-execute also applies to some small items, such as screwdrivers.
Notes: Press [E] to Takedown with an appropriate weapon.

BetterSpecialStrike.Description: Your feeble shoves are replaced with the mighty front-kick of an ancient Greek warrior.

Counter.Description: With a little shuffling of the feet, you can displace an opponent's unarmed energy and turn it against them, or sidestep out of the way of their melee attacks!
Notes: Tap [RMB] just before an opponent's hit lands.

CounterCharging.Description: Your counters now apply to charging and leaping opponents!

AdvancedGuard.Description: Your unarmed guard is tremendously effective when aimed directly at your attacker.

GuardAiming.Description: While guarding against attacks, you are able to aim in a direction to maximize your defense.

GuardMobility.Description: Learning better foot placement and balance has given you the ability to move in combat while maintaining your guard.

AdvancedGuardMobility.Description: Moving while guarding now happens at your standard speed.

Unarmed3.Description: Improve the quality of your Unarmed attacks.

PowerFinish.Description: Your killing blows are so massive that nearby opponents have a chance to be stunned.

Revelator.Description: Enemies you catch within cover will automatically be knocked to the floor by your unarmed attacks. Surprise!

StunningFist.Description: Your everyday unarmed attacks rarely fail to dizzy your opponents once your Combo reaches 10 hits.

DashHeavyAttack.Description: Offer your opponents a sweet jumpkick while sprinting to potentially send them flying across the battlefield.
Notes: Hold [SHIFT] and tap [LMB] while sprinting.

DodgeTackle.Description: When dodging, contact with enemies has a chance to knock them down or away.

PunchEnerv.Description: Not only do your strikes damage an opponent's Tac-Bar, but you'll deny your opponent ANY use of their Tac-Bar whatsoever for a couple seconds after every unarmed hit.

MeleeCounter.Description: Batting fists aside is easy, but countering an enemy's melee swing with your bare palms is the mark of a true unarmed champion.

MeleeGuard.Description: You can guard against melee attacks, be they swords or clubs, with as much ease as a fist or foot.

Arcane.Description: You have access to your own pocket dimension between worlds, where you can study the mystical arts and customize your collection of wands.
Notes: Enter the passage outside the HQ.

BribeEnemy.Description: You can spend your hard-earned cash to convert opponents to your side.
Notes: Hold [SHIFT] when initiating a Takedown

Corruption.Description: The essence of fallen opponents will sometimes return from death to aid you in battle. You'll also steal the essence of dizzied enemies to recover lost corpus blocks!

FreeExecute.Description: Once you have the Improvised Weapon skill, its effects apply to ALL melee weapons...so long as you can hold them in one hand.
Notes: Press [E] to Takedown with a melee weapon

Hungry.Description: Every Core Skill you purchase (excluding your weakeness) will make you bigger and slower, but much, much tougher.

ImaginaryFriend.Description: You keep telling people about your imaginary friend who helps you out of tough spots. Why won't anyone believe you?!

Infiltrator.Description: Enemies in Infiltration stages won't know you're an opponent until you're caught being violent, while all others have to hunt you down.

Operative.Description: Your pistols stunlock opponents, and will further ignore enemy Tac-Bar by one step once you have the Sweet Spot skill.

Replicate.Description: Instead of additional corpus, Core Focus Skills earn you clones that spawn in to help you in battle.

Scary.Description: Opponents startled by your takedowns and gruesome kills don't just react with surprise...they'll take off running!

Sturdy.Description: All skills you buy require you to pick from Strength or Endurance instead of their normal Attributes.

Throwmaster.Description: Your grenade slot weapons (daggers, javelines, etc.) pass through targets when they lose a corpus, hitting anyone beyond them. Plus, once you have the Lawnmower skill, it will apply to all weapons you throw!

Tinkerer.Description: You can stick any modification onto any firearm whatsoever with zero restriction. Enjoy!
Notes: Interact with the Weapon Modding Bench

Vanisher.Description: Once you have the Positioning skill, you'll teleport the distance between you and your target while wielding a melee weapon.

Warnings: Weapons can only be picked up by character with [Arcane] Skill

Notes: Characters holding weapons of this category will have a sluggish turning speed

Warnings: Apply this to melee weapons only

Notes: Characters with this preference will never pick up weapons
Warnings: Apply this to Melee weapons only
Apply this to Thrown weapons only

Notes: Automatically attached to off hand
Warnings: Apply this to Melee weapons only

Hero.Description: Character has regenerating helath, and temporary invunlerability after losing a corpus block

NoCombo.Description: Melee attacks are chosen at random instead of sequentially

NoWeapons.Description: Will use unarmed attacks even with weapons of any kind

Notes: amplitude of twitchiness dependent on [Level]

Deadly_Contact.Description: Will attempt to perform execution when in contact
Warnings: Can only perform executions where [Source] is designated as [Auto]

NoMelee.Description: Will use unarmed attacks even with melee weapons

WalkPulse.Description: Oscillates between full speed and reduced speed when moving

NoRanged.Description: Cannot use ranged weapons, treated as unarmed.

NoDisarm.Description: Cannot be disarmed and never reduces weapon durability

VanishDeactivate.Description: Body disappears after deactivation (happens after death)
Notes: Time to deactivation determined by [DeactivationTime]

Blind.Description: If unaware, can only wake up by sound
Notes: Woken up by gunshots and other allies waking up

EffectOnDeactivate.Description: [DeathEffect] occurs on deactivation instead of death

GrappleKiller.Description: Will maintain grapple even after breaking corpus block

NoCombatLock.Description: Does not lockdown the room while active

Unphased.Description: Does not use [WakeUpEmote] when spotting the player or when intimidated

TurretSpin.Description: Has a fixed turn speed dependent on [Dexterity]

Mushy.Description: Weapons stick into me, and gibs more easily
Warnings: Players and Bots cannot be rezzed with this trait

NoDizzy.Description: Cannot be dizzied by normal means

H2HAngry.Description: Will perform [Special_Angry] animation after hit 5 times

NoH2HSnap.Description: Does not keep tracking target during an Unarmed/Melee attack

WeakHands.Description: Unarmed attacks do not stun target

StaggerOnLowHealth.Description: When trauma is full, will fall to a looping dizzy stun
Notes: If enough time has passed, target will recover

DualWieldOverride.Description: Allows targets to dual wield without dual wielding skills

Lumbering.Description: When sprinting, will push smaller targets out of the way
Notes: Will push equally sized targets out of the way if using Charging behaviors

TwoHandOverride.Description: Can hold any weapon in one hand
Notes: Does not apply to weapons with [TwoHands] trait

Clumsy.Description: Will ragdoll and drop weapon if falling from any height

Deaf.Description: Can only be woken up by seeing the target

RemotePickup.Description: Can use the force to pick up weapons from afar

ZedProof.Description: Cannot be converted into another character

Heavy.Description: Cannot be knocked back as far

NoCombatRagdoll.Description: Cannot be ragdolled by weapons or losing a corpus block

ThrowForward.Description: Always throw items directly ahead of me instead of at my target

DashAttacker.Description: Always follow up sprinting at target with a dash attack

Unconvertable.Description: Cannot be converted into a character, or bribed

GrappleAttack.Description: Perform grapple attacks infrequently with unarmed attacks

StableRanged.Description: No recoil with any ranged weapons

HeftyOverride.Description: Can weild weapons normally too big for this character to use.

Invisible.Description: Enemies cannot target me until I attack them

BurnDeath.Description: Get set on fire while dying

NoMagazines.Description: Has no extra magazines regardless of ranged core skills

NoElementalDeath.Description: Do not use elemental death overrides

AlwaysBadThrow.Description: Always use encumbered throw when throwing melee weapons

Soulless.Description: Cannot be resurrected as a servant of the [Offering]

LeaveToPlayer.Description: Cannot be actively targeted by other enemies

NoIncap.Description: Will always die regardless of player control.

NoDeadZoneDamage.Description: Will not take Dead Zone damage and will instead just follow teleportation rules (if any)

TwoHands.Description: This weapon always requires two hands to use

ShowInOffHand.Description: This weapon will appear as being held in the off hand when equipped in the main hand
Notes: Held normally when dual wielding

RemoveOnEmpty.Description: Weapon is destroyed when ammo is depleted
Notes: Automatically applied to ranged weapons

Shuriken.Description: Weapon gains heatseeking when user has [ShurikenArc] skill

DisarmHit.Description: Hits from this weapon can disarm opponent

LeanBackHold.Description: User leans back while holding this weapon

NoStow.Description: When holstering attempted, will fall to floor instead

NotAWeapon.Description: Character holding this weapon will still use unarmed attacks and not benefit in any way

AutoEmbed.Description: Will wedge into anyone or anything it was thrown against

ReturnThrown.Description: Will return to the user after it hits the ground or comes to a stop
